text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: autoscaler-queue-backlog-high for service/inference-queue
alex.w: acked pagerduty. I'm looking at queue metrics now, seeing backlog spike to 180k items
maya.k: confirmed, backlog started ~2m ago post-burst from hosted API. latency for generation requests 95th=3.4s
sam.t: autoscaler HPA isn't scaling up past 8 replicas, hitting pod creation errors: ImagePullBackOff on some nodes
jen.p: any failed zones? nodes show disk pressure in us-west-2a
alex.w: rolling manual scale to 16 replicas as temporary. running:
```
kubectl scale deployment inference-worker -n prod --replicas=16
``` 
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident acknowledged by alex.w
maya.k: also toggling fallback routing to degraded-capacity model pool (lower memory) to shed pressure
sam.t: logs from scale-controller:
```
Err: failed to create pod: insufficient resources for pod
``` 
jen.p: hitting quota on gcp-project-limit for GPUs, requesting emergency quota bump via cloud-console. submitting ticket now
alex.w: manual surge started, seeing queue decrease to 60k after 90s, but some customer requests timed out (500s). Need impact assessment
maya.k: gathering list of affected customers from request logs, pushing to customer-impact doc. few high-traffic tenants saw increased latency/errors
sam.t: plan: 1) emergency quota 2) drain nodes with disk pressure 3) fix image pull by re-pushing image 4) add retry/backoff to scale-controller
jen.p: handing off to next oncall in 20m — @ops-shift please pick up once you see steady decline :thumbsup:
ops-shift: acknowledged, i'll monitor for 30m and follow up with post-incident notes
alex.w: marking this thread as incident-active. will update postmortem template and assign owners.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation to oncall-lead if not resolved in 15m
